description: Hollow enamel refrigerator with lined cabinet, shelf rails, clear shelves, stocked bins and a hinged door.
An electric kettle, ceramic mugs, saucers and a lipped wooden breakfast tray.
Bedside cabinet with a drawer, turned lamp, pleated shade and two clothbound books.
A china basin, chromed trap, towel rail and silvered mirror for small washrooms.
Low shower tray with tiled threshold, mixer, riser, rail, rose and slotted drain.
